You can export your ChatGPT conversations `using OpenAI's built-in data export tool, browser extensions, or manual methods`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF19jEuStA7npc_aQCi9SqtvmAKbTCWmiEElF0lMIyGP6IZqBpv7vzhaLk9Rwcx9HqTK6evtdiRrGusnO7h03zgeZ6CV3KqbPm77r9IzuLU7FyPjPS-dYkcNKk81sl2h4Wy803s2ZAvlt6nvYd5N04JWjQef4FtI7ieqBqh9vLT9XFbi-g0qylpJdqTcuEmNdZ5mzs2yh0UQk-X55Hy27OdGqPHpVhLMv9Js0wefPhlObk0JE0Dqzkb63JDjkr1F4XIaSLlRLcpMnFpo90ui2AG94)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)

### Method 1: Export All Chat History (Official Way)

OpenAI lets you download your entire chat history as a ZIP file containing JSON and HTML files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1zwXRadJ6g-8CLuOepGJrHKi1WY-fjIhEIsNLzDPMc6dBhTf7GZitfoSa6nvaPK7v_oIutwp7cJp2baSun8isQaCPQ-poPzEpu27pBIYOcUxDl3K2Zu1c-JVJIr_LRXR63OAE0IiaGdX9Wf8i0YxobNkiHCQWzCfto7rBACXyHw81qTq02LsSVdKfZc)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)

1. Log in to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXxnimszz4yAmroc93eLszbfex8BaIQ7ZO0ObTidFxe8Wc1E7eWxDvE3AlDAeIq61o7h9TiuTwuZxzPJI9HagRj9JNH1UbBsJuaQz-).
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings** > **Data controls**.
4. Click **Export** or **Export data** , then confirm the request.
5. Complete any verification prompts (such as a code sent via email or SMS).
6. Wait for an email from OpenAI (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days).
7. Click **Download data export** in the email. *Note: The link expires after 24 hours.* 
8. Unzip the downloaded file to view your data, which includes a readable `chat.html` file or raw JSON files.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1zwXRadJ6g-8CLuOepGJrHKi1WY-fjIhEIsNLzDPMc6dBhTf7GZitfoSa6nvaPK7v_oIutwp7cJp2baSun8isQaCPQ-poPzEpu27pBIYOcUxDl3K2Zu1c-JVJIr_LRXR63OAE0IiaGdX9Wf8i0YxobNkiHCQWzCfto7rBACXyHw81qTq02LsSVdKfZc)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXiKSFCHir_VDBXrLzpFrqIzNgV0yOWjK7Tzt_Tz0f0fXMywHD5PZMT8OIlz4Uza0wAl4Jymde7khRZlbKsYEPDCyzcdbY-fH411ioBhlEI70FoIVRsQf_J6gM-yV0XzzLP5C7U_9Kp4-mifLb)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)

### Method 2: Export a Single Conversation
If you only need to save or share one specific chat thread:

- **Share a read-only link:** Open the conversation, click the **Share** icon at the top right, and choose **Copy link**.
- **Save as PDF via browser:** Open the conversation, press `Ctrl + P` (Windows) or `Command + P` (Mac), and select **Save as PDF** as your destination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF11V3E4Pu4fcAu6L5yYVT86oylcADxdSxQqEBQfoIHXO6KkAae3ZuWDfRPPbveLtgrXd_rYTNnLfeSB8KjDrZOipJdtRxXzZXyMr2AeN36JNsKkWklWDZQmyCoCzKN2cXhjSjtnRPjESQ9GukGfa_vOtUSltNObu1SnvvmS74t8YYxTQZQFqm_50fRGrLYjMg8Vm6yu6n)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions or Scripts
Opinions are mixed on manual methods for large threads, as users on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF19jEuStA7npc_aQCi9SqtvmAKbTCWmiEElF0lMIyGP6IZqBpv7vzhaLk9Rwcx9HqTK6evtdiRrGusnO7h03zgeZ6CV3KqbPm77r9IzuLU7FyPjPS-dYkcNKk81sl2h4Wy803s2ZAvlt6nvYd5N04JWjQef4FtI7ieqBqh9vLT9XFbi-g0qylpJdqTcuEmNdZ5mzs2yh0UQk-X55Hy27OdGqPHpVhLMv9Js0wefPhlObk0JE0Dqzkb63JDjkr1F4XIaSLlRLcpMnFpo90ui2AG94) note that lengthy threads can become cumbersome to manage. Many users prefer third-party options for more readable formats like Markdown, Word, Notion, or PDF:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF19jEuStA7npc_aQCi9SqtvmAKbTCWmiEElF0lMIyGP6IZqBpv7vzhaLk9Rwcx9HqTK6evtdiRrGusnO7h03zgeZ6CV3KqbPm77r9IzuLU7FyPjPS-dYkcNKk81sl2h4Wy803s2ZAvlt6nvYd5N04JWjQef4FtI7ieqBqh9vLT9XFbi-g0qylpJdqTcuEmNdZ5mzs2yh0UQk-X55Hy27OdGqPHpVhLMv9Js0wefPhlObk0JE0Dqzkb63JDjkr1F4XIaSLlRLcpMnFpo90ui2AG94)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

- **Chrome Extensions:** Tools like [ExportGPT: Export ChatGPT Conversation](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) let you one-click export active chats into PDF, Markdown, HTML, or Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **Open Source Scripts:** Developers can use command-line tools or console scripts like the [ChatGPT Conversation Exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXhBCEqbvskTCExPy5IuJKHul8GvM2FV04bZ9DHSzSwP0PSLhvVAaYVvceoV2zL3LhY5sZw4FgBaou4PKgyg7s351XdGtw4fjRiFrDba7rRStfgTBuS83kmpqbdwHyFd9h8nvFgyg8WE5K1Hpd2-SdpBFk1IIsCPM) to pull full histories directly into local Markdown and JSON files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXhBCEqbvskTCExPy5IuJKHul8GvM2FV04bZ9DHSzSwP0PSLhvVAaYVvceoV2zL3LhY5sZw4FgBaou4PKgyg7s351XdGtw4fjRiFrDba7rRStfgTBuS83kmpqbdwHyFd9h8nvFgyg8WE5K1Hpd2-SdpBFk1IIsCPM)
